user.title: Connect to your Umaimi Chef server
user.description: Log in with your Umaimi Chef account. Home Assistant gets its own session; your password isn't stored.

data_description.url: For example http://192.168.1.10:8080 at home, or https://chef.example.ts.net

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Umaimi Chef again
reauth_confirm.description: The session for {email} has ended. Enter the password to log in again.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the server. Check the address, and that the server is running.

abort.already_configured: This Umaimi Chef account is already set up.

add_item.name: Add to a list
add_item.description: Adds an item to an Umaimi Chef inventory or shopping list, with its quantity (and on an inventory its date). The category last used for this name is filled in.

frozen_on.name: Date
frozen_on.description: On an inventory: the day it went in; today if left out. Not used on a shopping list.
